hero.name: DHRUV BHADHOTIYA
hero.tagline: Building intelligent systems that actually work in the real world.

lines: I'm a B.Tech (Hons.) Computer Science student specializing in AI & Analytics, and an ML researcher at CSIR–Fourth Paradigm Institute.
I work at the intersection of machine learning and security — graph neural networks, anomaly detection, and systems for the real world.
I like turning research into working software — from OCR-to-LLM platforms to fully offline multimodal assistants.

now.building: E-GraphSAGE — a GNN-based network intrusion detection system at CSIR-4PI
now.learning: distributed systems, graph ML, and writing papers that people actually read
now.listening: lo-fi loops and the hum of a good GPU fan
now.note: Preparing a paper for IEEE ANTS 2026 (IIT Roorkee). Open to research collaborations.

projects.name: SmartEval-AI
projects.desc: OCR-to-LLM exam grading platform. Flask + JWT + RBAC, Celery/Redis async processing, LM Studio-hosted LLM. Cut manual effort by ~80%.

projects.name: NOVA
projects.desc: Fully offline multimodal classroom assistant — text, voice and image inputs, local Phi-2 LLM, speech-to-text and BLIP captioning, optimized with OpenVINO.

projects.name: E-GraphSAGE
projects.desc: GNN-based network intrusion detection research at CSIR-4PI. Dual-specialist ensemble + focal loss on 2.5M-record UNSW-NB15 and CICIDS2018.

projects.name: OwnSquare
projects.desc: Full-stack PropTech/FinTech platform for fractional property investment with wallets, portfolios and role-based access for Admin, Broker and Investor.

projects.name: payora
projects.desc: AI-powered parametric income insurance for India's gig economy — automated payouts triggered by real-world signals.

projects.name: Network-Intrusion-GNN
projects.desc: Graph neural network experiments for network intrusion detection, exploring neighborhood aggregation on flow data.

projects.name: WebJava
projects.desc: Lightweight JavaScript-based Java code runner — compile and execute Java snippets seamlessly in Node.js or the browser.
